reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Best chicken in Cork, hands down. The ciabatta is absolutely next level — the piri piri mayo is something else.

reviews.name: James O'C.
reviews.text: The rotisserie chicken melts in your mouth. I drive across the city every weekend for this. Totally worth it.

reviews.name: Emma K.
reviews.text: Finally, proper chicken in Cork. The salad with smoked garlic dressing is insane. Became a regular instantly.

reviews.name: Ciarán B.
reviews.text: Weekend ritual sorted. Hansum is consistently incredible — every single visit. The whole chicken is a bargain.
